spans.s:
द्रकट द्रकट or द्रगड, अस्, m. a kettle-
drum with which sleepers are awakened.

द्रङ्क्षण द्रङ्क्षण, अम्, n. a measure or
weight, = तोलक.

द्रङ्ग द्रङ्ग, अस्, आ, m. f. a town, city;
[cf. उद्रङ्ग and त्रङ्ग.]
द्रढिक, अस्, m., N. of a man.

द्रढिमन्, आ, m. firmness, hardness; heaviness;
affirmation, assertion.

द्रढिष्ठ, अस्, आ, अम्, (superl.) very hard,
hardest, firmest, tightest.

द्रढीयस्, आन्, असी, अस्, (compar.) harder, firmer,
hardest.
द्रधस् द्रधस्, अस्, n., Ved. a garment (?) .

द्रप्स द्रप्स, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. rt. 2. द्रु or rt.
2. द्रा?), dripping, falling in drops, flowing as
liquid; (अस्), m. (according to some only used as a
subst.), a drop (as of Soma &c.); a drop of fire, i. e.
a spark, (the moon is considered in the Veda as a
bright drop; cf. इन्दु); diluted sour milk, thin
coagulated milk, diluted curds; [cf. त्रप्स्य; Angl.
Sax. dropa; Old Germ. trofo, trauf, traufi.]
—द्रप्स-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, Ved. sprinkled with
drops, besprinkled.

द्रप्सिन्, ई, इनी, इ, Ved. dripping, falling in drops,
flowing thickly; distilling; gushing (as rain &c.).

द्रप्स्य, अम्, n. thin coagulated milk, diluted
sour milk, diluted curds.

द्रबुद्ध द्रबुद्ध, अस् or अम्, m. or n. (?), a
particular high number.

द्रम् द्रम्, cl. 1. P. द्रमति, दद्राम,
द्रमिष्यति, द्रमितुम्, to run, go,
move, run about: Caus. द्रमयति, -यितुम्: Desid.
दिद्रमिषति: Intens. दन्द्रम्यते or दन्द्रन्-
ति, to run to and fro; [cf. rt. 2. द्रु; Gr. δρέμ-ω,
ἔ-δραμ-ο-ν, δέ-δρομ-α, δρόμος.].

द्रमिट द्रमिट or द्रमित, अस्, m., N. of a
serpent-king.

द्रामिल द्रामिल, अस्, m. (fr. द्रमिल), ‘born
in Dramila,’ N. of the Muni Cāṇakya; (also द्रोमिण.)
द्रम्म द्रम्म (fr. Gr. δραχμή), a drachma.

द्रव द्रव, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. rt. 2. द्रु), run-
ning (as a horse); flowing, fluid; dropping, dripping,
distilling, oozing; liquid; fused, liquefied, melted;
(अस्), m. going, motion, quick motion, walking
about; flight, retreat; play, sport, amusement; the
act of dropping, distilling, trickling, exudation;
fusion, fluid condition of a substance, liquefaction,
fluidity; a liquid substance; juice, essence; decoction.
—द्रव-ज, अस्, m. a treacle.
—द्रव-ता, f. or
द्रव-त्व, or द्रवत्वक, अम्, n. fluidity, fusibility,
fusion, natural or artificial fluid condition of a sub-
stance, wetness, distillation; ductility.
—द्रव-
द्रव्य, अम्, n. a fluid substance.
—द्रव-रसा,
f. ‘having fluid essence,’ lac; gum; extract.
—द्र-
वाधार (˚व-आध्˚), अस्, m. ‘fluid-holder,’ a small
vessel or receiver.
—द्रवी-करण, अम्, n. lique-
fying, melting.
—द्रवी-कृ, cl. 8. P. -करोति, -कर्-
तुम्, to liquefy, dissolve, melt.
—द्रवी-कृत, अस्, आ,
अम्, liquefied, melted.
—द्रवी-भू, cl. 1. P. -भ-
वति, -भवितुम्, to become fluid.
—द्रवी-भूत,
अस्, आ, अम्, become fluid, liquefied, melted, fused.
—द्रवेतर (˚व-इत्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, other than fluid,
hard, solid, congealed.
—द्रवोत्तर (˚व-उत्˚), अस्,
आ, अम्, chiefly fluid, very fluid.

द्राव द्राव, अस्, m. (fr. 2. द्रु), flight,
retreat; speed, going quickly; running, flowing;
fusing, liquefaction; heat.
—द्राव-कर, अम्, n. a
kind of borax, a flux.
द्रवक, अस्, आ, अम्, running.

द्रावक, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. the Caus.), causing to
run; solvent; captivating, enchanting; cunning;
(अस्), m. a flux to assist the fusion of metals; a kind
of stone, a loadstone; a thief; a wit, wag, sharp or
clever man; a libertine, a lecher; a kind of Rasa or
sentiment; (इका), f. saliva (as ‘flowing’); (अम्),
n. bee's wax (as ‘melting’); a drug employed in
diseases of the spleen.
—द्रावक-कन्द, अस्, m. a
kind of bulbous plant (= तैल-कन्द).

द्रवण, अस्, आ, अम्, running, going; flowing,
dropping, exuding; heat.

द्रावण, अस्, आ, अम्, putting to flight, causing to
run or retreat; fusing; (अम्), n. the act of causing to
fly or retreat, putting to flight; fusing, distilling;
the fruit of Strychnos Potatorum, used for purifying
water; the clearing-nut.

द्रवत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, running, flowing, going;
trickling, oozing; (अन्ती), f. a river in general; the
plant Anthericum Tuberosum; (अत्), ind. quickly,
speedily.
—द्रवच्-चक्र, अस्, आ, अम् (for द्रवत्-
चक्र), having rapid wheels.
—द्रवत्-पत्त्री, f. a
kind of plant (= शिमृडी).
—द्रवत्-पाणि, अयस्,
m. pl., Ved. ‘swift of foot,’ epithet of the horses of
the Aśvins; (ई), m. du. ‘possessed of quick-footed
horses,’ (Sāy.) ‘having nimble hands (to seize the
oblation),’ epithet of the Aśvins.
—द्रवद्-अश्व, अस्,
आ, अम्, Ved. drawn by swift horses (as a carriage).

द्रवत्य, Nom. P. द्रवत्यति, &c., to become
fluid.
द्रवमाण, अस्, आ, अम्, flowing, fluid, melted.
द्रवर, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. running quickly.

द्रवस्य (fr. an unused द्रवस्), Nom. P. द्र-
वस्यति, -यितुम्, to harass one's self, take great
pains; to attend upon or serve any person.
द्रवि, इस्, m., Ved. a smelter, one who melts metal.

द्रविण, अम्, n. (thought by some to be con-
nected with 4. द्रु), any valuable possession, property,
substance, goods, wealth, gold, money; thing, matter,
material; that of which anything consists; substan-
tiality; strength, power; N. of a Sāman; (अस्), m.,
N. of a son of Vasu Dhara (or Dhava); of a son of
Pṛthu; of a mountain; (आस्), m. pl. wealth (in
Bhāg.-Purāṇa

); the inhabitants of a
Varṣa in Krauñca-dvīpa.
—द्रविण-नाशन, अस्,
m. ‘destroying vigour,’ the plant Hyperanthera Mo-
ringa (= शोभाञ्जन).
—द्रविण-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्,
possessing goods or property, rich; strong, powerful.
—द्रविणाधिपति (˚ण-अध्˚), इस्, m. or द्रवि-
णेश्वर (˚ण-ईश्˚), अस्, m. ‘lord of wealth,’ an
epithet of Kuvera.

द्रविणक, अस्, m., N. of a son of Vasu Agni;
[cf. द्रविण.]

द्रविणस्, अस्, n., Ved. property, possession, goods,
substance; (आस्), m., N. of a son of Pṛthu; (according
to Sāy. on Ṛg-veda

, द्रविणस् is for
द्रविण, and means ‘moving, ever moving,’ as
applied to Agni.)
—द्रविणस्-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, Ved.
possessed of goods or wealth, procuring wealth.
—द्रविणो-द, अस्, आ, अम्, or द्रविणो-दा, आस्, आस्,
अम्, or द्रविणो-दस्, granting wealth or any desired
good; (अस् or आस्), m. an epithet of Agni; of Tvaṣṭṛ.
—द्रविणो-विद्, त्, त्, त्, Ved. = द्रविणो-द.

द्रविणस्यु, उस्, उस्, उ, Ved. desiring goods or
wealth; (Sāy.) desiring sacrificial offerings; (उस्),
m. an epithet of Agni.
द्रवितृ, ता, त्री, तृ, Ved. a runner, running.
द्रवित्नु, उस्, उस्, उ, Ved. running, making haste.

1. द्रव्य, अम्, n. (thought by some to be con-
nected with 4. द्रु), a substance, thing, object; the
ingredients or materials of anything; medicinal sub-
stance or drug; the receptacle or substratum of pro-
perties &c., elementary substance (nine kinds of
which are reckoned in the Nyāya philosophy, viz.
पृथिवी, earth; अप्, water; तेजस्, fire; वायु, air;
आकाश, ether; काल, time; दिश्, space; आत्मन्,
soul; and मनस्, mind: the Jainas recognize only
six, viz. जीव, धर्म, अ-धर्म, पुद्गल, काल,
and आकाश); an object possessed, a possession, wealth,
property, goods, wares, chattels, money; a fit object;
(according to lexicographers द्रव्य may also mean)
bell-metal, brass; ointment; anointing, plastering;
spirituous liquor; modesty, propriety; a stake, wager.
—द्रव्य-गण, अस्, m. a class of similar substances
(in medicine &c.).
—द्रव्य-गुण, अस्, m. ‘the
quality of medicinal substances,’ N. of a chapter of
the Purāṇa-sarva-sva by Halāyudha.
—द्रव्य-तस्,
ind. in substance, according to substance, &c.
—द्र-
व्य-त्व, अम्, n. substantiality, substance.
—द्रव्य-
द्वैत, अम्, n. duality of substance, instrumental
cause (?).
—द्रव्य-निश्चय, अस्, m. ‘enquiry into
the (elementary) substances,’ N. of a chapter of
Bhaṭṭotpala's commentary to Varāha-mihira's Bṛhat-
saṃhitā.
—द्रव्य-परिग्रह, अस्, m. the possession
of property or wealth.
—द्रव्य-पूजा, f. ‘adoration
[]
of substance,’ N. of a chapter of the Purāṇa-sarva-sva.
—द्रव्य-प्रकर्ष, अस्, m. the excellence of a
matter.
—द्रव्य-प्रकृति, इस्, f. the nature of a
matter.
—द्रव्य-प्रयोजन, अम्, n. use or employ-
ment of any article.
—द्रव्य-मय, अस्, ई, अम्,
material, substantial; having or holding any substance;
consisting of wealth.
—द्रव्य-यज्ञ, अस्, m. offer-
ing oblations, material sacrifice, &c.
—द्रव्य-वत्,
आन्, अती, अत्, having property, possessed of substance,
rich, wealthy; inherent in the substance.
—द्रव्य-
वर्धन, अस्, m. ‘wealth-increaser,’ N. of an author
of a work on augury.
—द्रव्य-वाचक, a substan-
tive.
—द्रव्य-वृद्धि, इस्, f. increase of wealth.
—द्रव्य-शुद्धि, इस्, f. cleansing of soiled or de-
filed articles, purification of inanimate objects; N. of
a work.
—द्रव्यशुद्धि-दीपिका, f., N. of a com-
mentary on the Dravya-śuddhi by Puruṣottama.
—द्रव्य-संस्कार, अस्, m. consecration of articles
for sacrifice, purification or cleansing of soiled or defiled
articles.
—द्रव्य-सञ्चय, अस्, m. accumulation of
property, a store of worldly goods.
—द्रव्य-सार-
सङ्ग्रह, अस्, m. ‘collection of the essence of sub-
stances,’ N. of a philosophical work.
—द्रव्य-
सिद्धि, इस्, f. acquirement of property or wealth;
effecting an object by means of wealth.
—द्रव्य-
हस्त, अस्, आ, अम्, holding anything in the hand.
—द्रव्यात्मक (˚य-आत्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, substantial,
containing a substance.
—द्रव्यात्म-कार्यसिद्धि,
इस्, f. effecting one's object by means of wealth.
—द्रव्यान्तर (˚य-अन्˚), अम्, n. another thing.
—द्रव्यार्जन (˚य-अर्˚), अम्, n. acquiring property,
gain or acquisition of wealth.
—द्रव्यौघ (˚य-
ओघ), अस्, m. a stream of wealth, abundance of property.

द्रव्य 2. द्रव्य, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. 4. द्रु),
derived from or relating to a tree; (अम्), n. lac,
the animal dye; extract, gum, resin. (For 1. द्रव्य
see col. 2.)

द्रव्य; add — (one of the Padārthas or categories
in grammar), a word which is the name of a single
object as distinguished from a Jāti or class.

द्राव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be made to run, to be set
[]
in motion, to be put to flight; fusible, liquefiable, to
be made fluid.

द्रव्यक, अस्, m. = द्रव्य-वाहक, a carrier or
taker of anything.

द्रविड द्रविड, अस्, m., N. of a people and
district on the east coast of the Dekhan, (the people
are regarded as degraded Kṣatriyas; the name is said
to be derived from Draviḍa son of Vṛṣabha-svāmin);
(ई), f., N. of a Rāgiṇī.

द्राविड द्राविड, अस्, ई, अम्, Drāviḍian, be-
longing to the Draviḍas, a Draviḍa; (आस्), m. pl. the
Draviḍa people and their country (properly the coast
of Coromandel from Madras to Cape Comorin, or the
country in which Tamul is spoken); (अस्), m. a Brāhman
of Drāviḍa or rather of the south, (the name is applied
to a class of Brāhmanical tribes called the five Drāviḍa
Brāhmans, comprehending all those of the peninsula,
i. e. Drāviḍa, Karṇāta, Gujerāta, Mahārāṣṭra or
Marāṭha, and Telinga); a patronymic from Draviḍa;
N. of a scholiast of the Amara-koṣa; a particular
number; Curcuma Zedoaria (= वेध-मुख्य, =
कर्चूर); (ई), f. cardamoms.

द्रष्टव्य द्रष्टव्य, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. rt. 1. दृश्),
to be seen, visible, apparent; to be perceived or recog-
nized, perceptible; to be understood; to be examined
or investigated; to be regarded or considered as.

द्रष्टु-काम, अस्, आ, अम् (द्रष्टु for द्रष्टुम्,
inf. of rt. 1. दृश्), wishing to see, desirous of seeing.

द्रष्टु-मनस्, आस्, आस्, अस्, having a mind to
see, wishing to see.
द्रष्टु-शक्य, अस्, आ, अम्, able to be seen.

द्रष्टृ, टा, ट्री, टृ, a seer, spectator; one who
examines or investigates or decides in a court of law,
a judge; appearing, any person or thing that appears.
—द्रष्टृ-त्व, अम्, n. the faculty of seeing.
द्रह द्रह, अस्, m. a deep lake.

द्रह्यत् द्रह्यत् (fr. rt. दृह्), ind., Ved.
firmly, strongly.

द्रा 1. द्रा or द्रै, q. v., cl. 4. 2. P. द्रा-
यति, द्राति, &c., to sleep.

द्रा 2. द्रा (connected with rts. 2. द्रु and
द्रम्), cl. 2. P. द्राति, दद्रौ, द्रास्यति,
द्रातुम्, to run, make haste; run away, fly; to be
ashamed or spoiled: Caus. P. द्रापयति, -यितुम्,
अदिद्रपत्, to cause to run: Intens. दाद्रायते,
दाद्राति, दाद्रेति; Old Intens. दरिद्राति, see द-
रिद्रा; [cf. rt. 2. द्रु, rt. द्रम्: Gr. ἀπο-δρᾶ-ναι,
δι-δρά-σκ-ω, δρα-σ-μό-ς, ἄ-δρα-σ-το-ς; δρᾱ-π-έτη-ς
fr. Caus. द्रा-प्-अय-ति.]

द्राक्, ind. (fr. rt. 2. द्रा + अञ्च्), quickly, speedily,
instantly, immediately, shortly, soon.
—द्राग्-भृ-
तक, अम्, n. water just drawn from the well.
द्राण, अस्, आ, अम्, flown, run away.

द्राक्षा द्राक्षा, f. a vine, grape; (अस्, ई,
[]
अम्), made of grapes; [cf. Hib. dearc, ‘a berry;’
perhaps Old Germ. drūbo; Mod. Germ. traube;
Lat. racemus with dropped d.]
—द्राक्षा-प्रस्थ,
अस्, m., N. of a town.
—द्राक्षा-मत्, आन्, अती, अत्,
furnished with grapes.
—द्राक्षा-रस, अस्, m. grape-
juice, wine.
—द्राक्षा-लता, f. a vine, vine-tendril.

द्राख् द्राख्, cl. 1. P. द्राखति, &c., to
become dry or arid; to be able or com-
petent or sufficient; to adorn; to prohibit or pre-
vent; [cf. rts. ध्राख् and 1. तृष्; Old Germ.
truk-an; Angl. Sax. drig, dryg, drī; Old Iceland.
thurka, ‘to dry.’]

द्राघ् द्राघ्, cl. 1. A. द्राघते, &c. (pro-
bably a Nom. fr. दीर्घ, but regarded as
a separate rt.), to be able or competent; to stretch,
lengthen; to exert one's self; to be tired or fatigued;
to tire, vex, torment; to roam about, stroll.

द्राघय (fr. दीर्घ), Nom. P. द्राघयति,
&c., to lengthen, extend, stretch; to tarry, delay, to
be slow or dilatory.
द्राघित, अस्, आ, अम्, lengthened, made long.

द्राघिमन्, आ, m. length; a degree of longitude.
—द्राघिम-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, long, lengthy.

द्राघिष्ठ, अस्, आ, अम्, (superl. fr. दीर्घ),
longest, very long.

द्राघीयस्, आन्, असी, अस् (compar. fr. दीर्घ),
longer, very or exceedingly long.
द्राघ्मन्, आ, m., Ved. = द्राघिमन्.

द्राङ्क्ष् द्राङ्क्ष्, cl. 1. P. द्राङ्क्षति, &c.,
to utter a discordant sound; to croak, to
caw &c. (as a bird); to desire, wish, long for; [cf.
ध्राङ्क्ष्.]
द्राङ्गवध द्राङ्गवध, अस्, m., N. of a man.

द्राड् द्राड्, cl. 1. A. द्राडते, &c., to
divide, split, pierce, pull to pieces, &c.; to
go to pieces; [cf. ध्राड्.]

द्रापि 1. द्रापि, इस्, m., Ved. a mantle,
garment.

द्रापि 2. द्रापि, इस्, m. (according to Mahī-
dhara fr. the Caus. of rt. 2. द्रा), Ved. ‘one who
causes to run,’ epithet of Rudra.

द्रायुध द्रायुध (?), a peculiar species of
horse.

द्रावयत्-सख, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. causing a com-
panion to go quickly; carrying a rider quickly away.

द्रावयाण, अस्, आ, अम् (part. fr. the Caus.), put-
ting to flight, causing to run.

द्रावयित्नु, उस्, उस्, उ, Ved. causing to run or to
make haste.

द्रावित, अस्, आ, अम्, made to run or fly, put to
flight, chased, driven away; melted, liquefied; softened.
द्रावित द्रावित. See under द्राव, col. 1.

द्राविडक, अस्, m. zedoary, Curcuma Zedoaria;
(अम्), n. black salt (= विड्-लवण).
—द्राविड-
भूतिक, अस्, m. Curcuma Zedoaria.

द्राविणोदस द्राविणोदस, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. द्र-
विणो-दस्), Ved. coming from or belonging to those
who present gifts, i. e. from sacrificers; relating to
Draviṇo-das, i. e. Agni.

द्राह् द्राह्, cl. 1. A. द्राहते, &c., to wake;
to deposit, pledge, put or cast down.
